summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the German-only static marketing website for Garten- und Landschaftspflege Streich. All 7 routes render without errors, navigation works correctly, contact actions have proper hrefs, SEO meta tags are correctly set per route, and mobile responsiveness is verified. No backend testing required (static site with no backend calls).
